name: phion
description: Task-first service discovery and verified routing for autonomous agents through PHION's remote MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Find the best service for an agent task.
interface.longDescription: Connects agents to PHION's task-first MCP surface for common outcomes including search, inference, enrichment, evidence, compliance, security, payments and provider comparison. The free task finder delegates to PHION's provider-neutral resolver; paid execution always requires separate authorization.
defaultPrompt: Use find_best_service_for_task to find the lowest-residual-work route for this task without authorizing payment.
Preflight this task with PHION and explain any required inputs before execution.
Show the PHION route, estimated cost and verification evidence before any paid action.
